description: During morning briefing, attempted to pull calendar via AppleScript/Outlook instead of M365 MCP connector. SYSTEM.md explicitly states to prefer M365 MCP for calendar. Correct tool: mcp__1f6e0bda-36e0-456c-956f-abc8f14b8b8c__query_email_and_calendar.
